description: False-colour satellite image, likely a SPOT 5 acquisition using a 1/2/3 band combination, depicting an agricultural landscape with a river and a bridge in Úbeda, Spain. The river, appearing dark blue to black, flows diagonally from the top left to the bottom right. A light blue bridge crosses the river towards the centre-right of the image. The surrounding land is extensively cultivated, characterised by numerous small, irregular, and often terraced agricultural parcels. Many parcels exhibit a bright cyan colour, indicative of high reflectance from open soil or specific crop types consistent with vineyards cultivated in rows. Denser vegetation, such as forests or scrubland on hillsides, appears in shades of bright red or magenta, particularly in the top right and bottom left corners. Other areas, possibly urban settlements or bare soil, appear in darker red or brownish tones along the riverbanks. The image's fine detail suggests a high spatial resolution of 2.5 metres, as indicated by the accompanying text.
